agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A nonzero staged-whitespace gate must stop the command sequence before commit.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The plan commit proceeded after git diff --cached --check reported trailing blank-line whitespace because later commands masked its exit status.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The committed plan diff was inspected immediately afterward and the whitespace warning was reproduced without any runtime or provider activity.

correction.action: Remove the whitespace in a dedicated mechanical descendant commit before implementation or execution.
correction.prevention_control: Critical gates are now followed by immediate LASTEXITCODE checks and staged scope is validated separately before commit.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the masked staged-whitespace gate and corrected mechanical descendant.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The opt-in canonical serializer must leave the default generated wrapper byte-identical to accepted historical evidence.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first conditional-template draft inserted one extra blank line into default wrapper output.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The focused historical equality test rejected the draft before staging, commit or Node execution.

correction.action: Place the conditional serializer at the existing template boundary without introducing default-mode whitespace.
correction.prevention_control: The focused test now generates both default and canonical modes and the predecessor equality suite remains mandatory.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected default-wrapper byte perturbation and byte-compatible conditional correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every safe diagnostic emitted by the generated wrapper must match the reader's recursive canonical JSON bytes.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Attempt 001 produced three semantically safe sidecars in JavaScript insertion order, and all three were rejected with diagnostic_canonical_bytes_required.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The exact four-process authored fixture rehearsal preserved immutable attempt-001 evidence with three identical canonical-byte rejection coordinates.

correction.action: Add the plan-admitted opt-in recursive key-order serializer and execute one fresh exact four-scenario attempt.
correction.prevention_control: Canonical mode validates its serializer source shape and the real-Node rehearsal requires three byte-canonical diagnostics.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the real-Node insertion-order defect and passing canonical attempt 002 correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A required pre-commit receipt invocation must have its exit and terminal status checked immediately before later commands can mask it.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first combined recovery command invoked preflight and then several later checks without an immediate exit guard, so the displayed output did not prove the receipt status.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: A separate fail-closed readback immediately parsed the preserved receipt, confirmed status passed and re-ran the whitespace gate before staging.

correction.action: Parse the preserved receipt in a separate command, require passed status and stop before staging on any mismatch.
correction.prevention_control: Subsequent preflight commands use immediate LASTEXITCODE and receipt-status guards before any later command.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the pre-commit exit-check lapse and explicit fail-closed receipt readback.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The prospective human register revision reading must exist and bind the projected revision before clockwork transaction preparation resolves node evidence.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout check referenced revision 580 in node evidence before the required human reading artifact existed, so transaction preparation rejected evidence_not_found.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The read-only clockwork check returned tick_transaction_prepare before command execution, publication or canonical mutation.

correction.action: Author the exact revision 580 reading with all projected incident IDs and counts before rerunning the unchanged closeout transaction.
correction.prevention_control: Future incident-bearing clockwork closeouts create and validate the prospective reading artifact before the first transaction check.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the missing prospective register reading and corrected dependency ordering before canonical mutation.
